title: FlapLab Daily — Albexit.exe
story: You are Albertaball. Ten referendum questions, one Calgary Tower after another, all asking the same thing: stay a province or start packing? Flap through the Rockies and try not to secede into a tower.
inspiration: Alberta's 19 Oct 2026 referendum — 10 questions including whether to remain a province or begin constitutional steps toward separation; Carney campaigned for unity in Edmonton, polls ~70% stay / ~22% separate (X Trending 'Alberta Referendum Tests Unity with Separation Option', x.com/i/trending/2109388757682331706, 13 Oct). Albertaball drawn from the official Flag of Alberta SVG (Wikimedia), Calgary Tower photo (Wikimedia, rembg), Moraine Lake / Banff (Wikimedia).
